methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: 按 id 单条增量更新（浅合并 patch 后走 sanitize 清洗；找不到或非法 patch 返回 false）

methods.name: scrollToTask
methods.description: 滚动到指定任务行（虚拟滚动下委托内部视口，目标行垂直居中）；找不到为空操作。

methods.name: scrollToDate
methods.description: 滚动到指定日期（水平居中）；非法日期忽略。RTL 走真实浏览器 scrollLeft 负值模型

methods.name: undo
methods.description: 撤销最近一次任务数据提交；返回是否实际撤销

methods.name: redo
methods.description: 重做最近一次撤销；返回是否实际重做

methods.name: clearHistory
methods.description: 清空撤销/重做历史（不改变当前任务）

methods.name: removeTasks
methods.description: 批量删除任务（连同其后代）；找不到即忽略

methods.name: addTask
methods.signature: addTask(task: Partial<GanttTask>, opts: { parent?: string | null; before?: string; after?: string }): string
methods.description: 新增任务（命令式创作通道）：返回新任务 id；非法输入返回 ''（零改动、零事件）。

methods.name: moveTask
methods.signature: moveTask(id: string, opts: { parent?: string | null; index?: number }): boolean
methods.description: 移动任务到指定父级（opts.parent 省略保持原父级、null 移为根级）下的第 index 位

methods.name: duplicateTask
methods.signature: duplicateTask(id: string, opts: { id?: string; name?: string; parent?: string | null }): string | null
methods.description: 复制任务及其全部后代（深拷贝、各自新 id，父指针映射到新 id），紧跟原子树之后插入，返回新根 id；

methods.name: addDependency
methods.signature: addDependency(taskId: string, dep: { id: string; type?: 'fs' | 'ss' | 'ff' | 'sf'; lag?: number }): boolean
methods.description: 新增依赖（后继 taskId 依赖 dep.id）：type 缺省 fs；lag（天，可负）可选，缺省不写（等价 0）。

methods.name: removeDependency
methods.signature: removeDependency(taskId: string, dep: { id: string; type?: 'fs' | 'ss' | 'ff' | 'sf' }): boolean
methods.description: 删除依赖：dep.type 给出只删该 (id,type)；未给出删该 id 的全部类型。找不到返回 false。

methods.name: updateDependency
methods.signature: updateDependency(taskId: string, from: { id: string; type?: 'fs' | 'ss' | 'ff' | 'sf'; lag?: number }, to: { id: string; type?: 'fs' | 'ss' | 'ff' | 'sf'; lag?: number }): boolean
methods.description: 改写依赖：from 找不到 / to.id 不存在或指向自身 / 无实际变化（含 lag）→ false。

methods.name: updateTasks
methods.signature: updateTasks(patches: Array<{ id: string } & Partial<GanttTask>>): number
methods.description: 批量浅合并（逐条：id 不存在跳过；end 给非空且解析失败跳过该条；其余走 sanitize 单条清洗，

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: 向更细一档步进（写 scale 属性，既有回调派发 oas-scale-change）；最细档 no-op

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: 向更粗一档步进；最粗档 no-op

methods.name: fit
methods.description: 缩放以容纳全部任务：取**最细且**能满足「跨度按该档单位折算的列数 × 该档最小列宽 ≤ 可用宽」的档

events.name: oas-history-change
events.detail: { canUndo: this.undoStack.length > 0, canRedo: this.redoStack.length > 0, action, } satisfies GanttHistoryChangeDetail

events.name: oas-window-request
events.detail: { start: need.start, end: need.end, reason } satisfies WindowRequestDetail | { start: need.start, end: need.end, reason: 'scroll' } satisfies WindowRequestDetail

events.name: oas-range-request
events.detail: { startMs: need.startMs, endMs: need.endMs, reason } satisfies RangeRequestDetail

events.name: oas-task-render
events.detail: { task: this.taskSnapshot(row.task), element: bar } satisfies GanttTaskRenderDetail

events.name: oas-task-click
events.detail: { id: row.task.id, task: this.taskSnapshot(row.task) } satisfies GanttTaskClickDetail

events.name: oas-task-dblclick
events.detail: { id: row.task.id, task: this.taskSnapshot(row.task) } satisfies GanttTaskClickDetail

events.name: oas-reparent
events.detail: { id: dragId, parent, index } satisfies GanttReparentDetail | { id, parent, index } satisfies GanttReparentDetail

events.name: oas-dependencies-change
events.detail: { taskId: t.id, dependencies: (t.dependencies ?? []).map((d) => ({ ...d })), } satisfies GanttDependenciesChangeDetail | { taskId, dependencies: next.map((d) => ({ ...d })), } satisfies GanttDependenciesChangeDetail | { taskId: succ.id, dependencies: deps.map((d) => ({ ...d })), } satisfies GanttDependenciesChangeDetail

events.name: oas-task-add
events.detail: { id, task: this.taskSnapshot(clean) } satisfies GanttTaskAddDetail | { id: newRoot.id, task: this.taskSnapshot(newRoot) } satisfies GanttTaskAddDetail

events.name: oas-task-change
events.detail: { id, task: this.taskSnapshot(finalTask), oldStart: this.fmtIso(oldStartMs, datetime), oldEnd: milestone ? this.fmtIso(oldStartMs, datetime) : this.fmtEnd(oldEndMs, datetime), start: finalTask.start, end: finalTask.end ?? finalTask.start, } satisfies GanttTaskChangeDetail

events.name: oas-progress-change
events.detail: { id, task: this.taskSnapshot(this._tasks.find((t) => t.id === id)!), progress, } satisfies GanttProgressChangeDetail
